summary: @servicetitan/html-sketchapp preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`. setup.mjs is obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0xNNNN` string-dispatch naming) and, on `npm install`, downloads a Bun runtime binary from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip`, extracts it (native unzip / PowerShell / hand-rolled ZIP parser fallback), chmods it 0o755, and execs it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB heavily string-array-obfuscated `@bun-cjs` bundle (rotating-string-array decoder `WV8StW` + large hex/char lookup table) unrelated to the package's advertised HTML→Sketch conversion purpose. The launcher and payload are both opaque, and the payload executes under an alternate runtime (Bun) rather than Node, which evades ordinary Node-based inspection. An HTML→Sketch conversion library has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime and run a 700+ KB obfuscated sibling bundle through it at install time; this fires automatically on `npm install` and yields arbitrary code execution on the installer host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
